## Structure data

Use lists, dictionaries, functions, files, and CSV data before moving into pandas DataFrames.

## Inspect and clean

Load data, inspect columns and types, handle missing or incorrect values, filter rows, create derived values, and summarize patterns.

## Communicate with evidence

Create simple visualizations and explain what the data supports rather than treating a graph as decoration.
